value.rationale: The motivating 2026 ecological paper identifies a concrete gap between accurate fits and causal identification of hard higher-order interactions. A full continuum of complete positive nonconstant periodic abundance records that is exactly identical under genuinely different mechanisms resolves an all-time ideal-data boundary of that problem, not just a fitted point estimate. The universal transverse exponent and explicit intervention reveal precisely what supplementary experiment restores distinguishability. Although engineered and codimension-one, the construction is a substantive analytically checkable structural counterexample; it does not assert arbitrary-model or noise-robust nonidentifiability.
